pairs.why: Both are nearly the same render; A's inkwell and quill are slightly larger and fill the frame more like the real cards, and the feather is a little less sharply carved.
The two are almost identical in finish, glass gloss and carved-looking feather, so neither is clearly closer to the softer real cards.
B's bottle is a bit fuller and rounder with slightly softer highlights, closer to the plump forms of the real gloves and chair, though the difference is marginal.
A's glass has slightly softer, less mirror-like reflections and its quill sits more naturally in the bottle, so it reads a little less like a glossy statue.
A sits on a warmer, more saturated floor with softer shading, which is slightly closer to the real cards' warm lighting; the objects themselves are nearly identical.
Both share the same carved-wood feather and glossy green glass with no meaningful difference in rendering or build.
A's bottle is rounder and its feather a bit softer and less ridged, slightly closer to the smooth but not ultra-smooth finish of the real cards than B's sharper, more sculpted quill.
A's inkwell is a little larger and plumper, with softer floor reflections, a marginal edge in matching the chunky, warm real cards.
